layout_pattern:
Format: rows separated by spaces. 
Prefix a letter with a number to repeat it (4A -> AAAA). Append *N to repeat the whole row N times. 
Example: 4A3B2C*3 AABBCC -> AAAABBBCC drawn 3 times, then AABBCC.
gate_connected_to:
Specify the device letter whose diffusion source/drain (S/D) is connected to its own gate. 
The gate of this device is linked to its S/D, so enter the letter of that device.
diff_connected:
Specify devices whose diffusion (S/D) terminals are connected together.

Group devices that share the same net into one block, and separate different nets with a space.

Example:
If devices A, B, C, D exist and A/B sources are connected, and C/D sources are connected:

AB CD
odd_vertical:
Check this box to route odd-numbered metals vertically and even-numbered metals horizontally.

Uncheck it for the inverse: odd-numbered metals horizontal and even-numbered metals vertical.
metal_level:
Specify the minimum (starting) metal layer used for routing.

Routing can only use this layer and above; lower metals are reserved and skipped.

Example:
If devices normally route with two levels — met1 horizontal and met2 vertical — setting this to 2 forces routing to start at met2 instead. The two-level pair then shifts up: met2 (vertical) and met3 (horizontal).

In short: raising this value shifts your whole routing stack up, leaving the lower metals untouched.
